name: 01_alignment_method_coverage
title: Alignment methods and coverage
interpretation: Counts show modern BV-encoded-photodiode, older frame-modulo, and unclassified sessions by modality.
limitation: Presence of a saved alignment method does not prove SLAP2 source-sample timing.

name: 02_bv_harp_clock_offset
title: BonVision-to-HARP fitted clock origin offset
source: behavior/alignment_meta.json: intercept × 1000; method labels from alignment_method
interpretation: Describes the relative origin of fitted BonVision and HARP coordinate systems for each session.
limitation: NOT imaging-to-stimulus latency; intercepts with different time-zero definitions may be incomparable.

name: 03_bv_harp_residuals
title: BonVision-to-HARP photodiode residuals and legacy fit consistency
source: Modern: Bonsai photodiode-state transitions + HARP AnalogInput0, local detector matching repository threshold/debounce, 1-in-5 edge holdout. Legacy: frame-modulo transitions compared with HARP edges using saved affine fit.
interpretation: Modern series reflects predictive mapping precision at withheld anchors; fallback series reflects fit consistency.
limitation: Not imaging-to-HARP accuracy. Detection/pairing is shared with processing; legacy periodic ambiguity remains. 60 Hz guide illustrative.

name: 04_harp_pd_to_di3_phase
title: HARP photodiode event phase relative to DI3
source: HARP AnalogInput0 photodiode rise indexes vs HARP DI3 digital rising-edge timestamps from HARP_df.csv (original raw index values)
interpretation: Measures whether display transitions precede or follow nearest SLAP2 acquisition-clock edges within shared HARP timestamps.
limitation: DI3 generally tracks DMD1 cycle edges, not individual DMD1/DMD2 samples. Nearest-pulse phase is bounded/periodic, is not absolute lag, and depends on shared HARP index origin.

name: 05_di3_clock_cadence
title: DI3 acquisition-clock cadence across sessions
source: HARP_df.csv DI3 rising edges, or qc/behavior/di3_pulse_train_detection.json when raw CSV not scanned
interpretation: Describes the recorded acquisition-clock period per session. Changes can reflect acquisition configuration, not failures.
limitation: Does not uniquely establish imaging absolute phase, line-index mapping, or DMD2 sampling rate; gaps between acquisition epochs are not dropped-pulse evidence.

name: 06_extraction_boundary_conventions
title: Source extraction boundary diagnostics
source: Legacy voltage dendriticVoltageTraces HDF5 /traces/trial_* line attributes and literal boundary ROI samples; GIAnT experiment_summary.h5 /Path*/frame_info/frame_line_idxs
interpretation: Documents processing timestamp conventions and possible duplicate source samples per session.
limitation: GIAnT line-index evidence is distinct from voltage trial edges. Duplicate samples / nominal rate ≠ demonstrated end-to-end drift; no automatic session exclusion.

name: 07_focus_bv_harp_residuals
title: Single-session behavior photodiode alignment over time
source: Modern: paired BonVision encoded rises and HARP analog PD rises with 1-in-5 anchor holdout; legacy: reported modulo-frame affine fit to HARP analog PD edges
interpretation: Shows residual variability, outliers and temporal structure in the behavior-clock mapping.
limitation: Residuals do not include SLAP2 source-line registration. Legacy method is not an independent held-out test.

name: 08_focus_hardware_event_phase
title: Single-session HARP photodiode to DI3 pulse phase
source: Raw HARP AnalogInput0 transition timestamps vs raw HARP DI3 digital pulse timestamps, using native HARP index values
interpretation: Visualizes temporal phase of display transitions relative to acquired cycle edges.
limitation: Periodic sawtooth/wraps expected for asynchronous stimulus and acquisition clocks. Not an absolute imaging sample lag.

name: 09_focus_hardware_events
title: Raw HARP clock edges and stimulus photodiode transitions
source: HARP_df.csv DI3 rising-edge indexes and AnalogInput0 detected photodiode transitions; both HARP timestamp domains
interpretation: Shows recorded acquisition cycles and the timing of a real display-light transition in the same time neighborhood.
limitation: PD transition occurs on toggled photodiode marker, not every visual stimulus; no single-sample DMD2 mapping is inferred.

name: 10_t03_criterion_disposition
title: Original one-display-frame T0.3 acceptance and evidence status
source: Registry cohort; independently verified imaging↔HARP error and measured display frame period if provided in separate evidence CSV
interpretation: Distinguishes proven PASS/FAIL from pending independent source-clock mapping.
limitation: Missing evidence is pending rather than scientific failure; weak surrogate metrics never promote sessions to PASS.
